title: Interactive Torus Parametrization of the One-Dimensional Fibonacci Quasicrystal
summary: We present an interactive computational framework for exploring the torus parametrization of the one-dimensional Fibonacci quasicrystal and its local hull. While cut-and-project schemes and Fourier analysis of local functions have been actively explored, a purely algebraic treatment still requires deeper geometric intuition regarding the underlying dynamical systems to advance these methods further.
